$description: Projects design system 0.30.0: design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10. Generated by design build from tokens/*.json; do not edit.

color.$description: Semantic colours. The spec has no modes, so each theme is its own group.

accent.$description: The approved accents. 'accent' is the brand colour for borders, bars, focus and fills, 'accent-text' the AA-safe shade for accent text and links, 'on-accent' the text on a fill. accent-hover, accent-soft and focus are derived from the accent in CSS and not exported.

shadow.$description: Floating-surface shadows per theme (darker in dark mode).

design.skipped: --fluid-display: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 4vw, 3.5rem) (clamp() cannot be expressed as a dimension)
--fluid-section: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 5vw, 5rem) (clamp() cannot be expressed as a dimension)
$extensions.design.themes: Themes are groups (color.dark, color.light, shadow.dark, shadow.light, accent.<name>.dark|light): the 2025.10 format defines no modes.
